controller: MediaPipe-only MCP-to-tip arrow-angle open-loop servo controller
stationary_gesture: STOP only; short arrow or unassigned angle sector; no neutral/release hold
up_gesture: continuous reverse on ALL three motors at configured speed; respects per-servo signs; not limited by winding estimates
arming_policy: exact READY confirmation plus enable-motion authorizes automatic arming/resumption for entire session; no A key or neutral pose required
startup_frame_age_policy: eight consecutive fresh valid single-hand frames before automatic arm; first ARM command is ZERO and next motion uses a new frame; 150ms deadline unchanged
tracking_loss_policy: STOP/disarm motors and keep preview running; READY authorization persists and fresh current hand frames trigger automatic resumption
tracking_pause_preserves: winding and command-history telemetry; no travel budgets or permanent rearm latch
left_right_mode: continuous while held, without travel/time/dwell cutoff; direct direction changes; STOP stops
servo_1_mode: continuous BACK while held; no pulse expiry
unloaded_free_spin_mode: legacy --unloaded-test flag retained for compatibility; same unlimited-travel policy as normal operation
normal_mode_travel_protection: removed at user request; no signed/cumulative/session/pulse cutoff in any mode
runtime_fault_policy: STOP/disarm, keep preview open; READY-authorized automatic STOP/PING/ARM retries after healthy tracking; serial retry interval >=1 second
retained_checks: explicit READY consent, motion-enable flag, speed bounds, fresh-frame/loop deadlines, serial acknowledgements, firmware watchdog
coordinated_return: only estimated previously wound nonselected motors; half speed, tapered near estimated home
warning: Synthetic/mocked tests do not verify neutral calibration, physical rotation directions, tracking accuracy, or safe tendon tension.
